test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly visited the Magento admin customer_online grid (admin_url). The filter payloads in the URLs (steps 8 and 10) are base64-encoded and decode to parameters including customer_id[from]=100 and customer_id[to]=200. Step 10 shows firstname=Alice and email=alice@example.com and last_url=/checkout/onepage/ (type was sent as 'c' => Customer). I used the most recent filter values (Alice / alice@example.com) plus the observed ID range (100–200). Other fields were not present in the filters so they are left empty.
